title: Give me a Python snippet that streams from this server.

messages.content: Give me a Python snippet that streams from this server.

Here is a Python snippet that uses the `requests` library to stream data from a server. This code will stream the response from a web page without downloading the entire content into memory at once.

```python
import requests

def stream_from_server(url):
    response = requests.get(url, stream=True)
    
    for chunk in response.iter_content(1024):
        if chunk:  # filter out keep-alive chunk
            print(chunk)

# Example usage:
stream_from_server('http://www.example.com')
```

This script will print the data as it comes in from the server, and won't try to store everything in memory at once. This is useful for large files or pages that wouldn't fit into memory.

Please replace `'http://www.example.com'` with the URL of the server you want to stream from.

Remember to install requests library if you haven't installed yet. You can install it using pip:
```
pip install requests
```

Also, keep in mind that this script does not handle different types of data (e.g., HTML, JSON) differently. You might need to modify the script to parse and handle the data appropriately depending on your use case.
